Definition: neuter of a compound of G5140 and G3376 as noun; a three months' space:--three months.
BiblicalUsage: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child. By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child, and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the short time holds a whole theology: faith that hides a child for three months, and a king whose commandment it does not fear.
